description: EC1 federal competition and foreign-investment instruments, normalized from the prepared cluster-2 inventory.
notes: Normalized from prompts/cluster-2-batches/lex-mex-cl2-batch-EC1.json for the repository Rust ingestion gate.
All six prepared entries were absent from adapters, corpus/mx, and existing operational batch manifests when this manifest was created.
Prepared dof_publication/dof_last_reform fields are provenance context, not operational batch-manifest properties, and are therefore intentionally omitted.
The planned first pass is lfce only: inspect its source manifest, positional furniture report, canonical diff, and validation before freezing counts or processing the remaining EC1 entries.

lrsic is held out: its original transitory QUINTO cites LRAF Articles 33-A and 33-B, which do not exist in the already-committed current LRAF corpus. The reference-graph rule deliberately fails this stale-cross-reference-to-repealed-provision case rather than silently dropping edges; resolving it requires the same corpus-wide policy decision as lcnbv.
